description: Public PressureEqualizer logical-position and active-tool state transitions, checked through emitted movement and extrusion.

mutants.description: Force every G92 E value to zero. The fixture uses G92 E5, so the following public G1 is assigned a six-millimeter internal E jump instead of one millimeter; the ordinary move-count oracle then observes a different pressure-smoothing result.

Force every changed tool to filament slot 0. With configured 1.75 mm and 3.5 mm filaments, the second block no longer crosses the pressure-smoothing segmentation threshold and fails the move-count oracle while extrusion and endpoint conservation remain ordinary output assertions.
